note: A complexity theorist's account of the autumn's AI-assisted results in theoretical computer science, including an Anthropic-model-found algorithm refuting the 3SUM conjecture and OpenAI's claimed refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis and faster integer-multiplication algorithm. He says they do not prove P = NP but support his long-held belief that it holds, and calls for open, publicly accessible AI tools. The claims are the author's account.
title: What happened in fall 2026: AI and P vs NP
